title: Chem Lab: Element Match
description: Match chemical elements to trigger reactions and form compounds! Swap adjacent elements on the grid to create chains of Hydrogen, Oxygen, Carbon, Nitrogen, and Sodium. Learn about the periodic table, chemical formulas, and reactions through colorful puzzle matching.
learning_objectives: Learn to identify common chemical elements and their symbols
Understand how elements combine to form chemical compounds
Explore basic chemical reactions through pattern matching
Practice strategic thinking by planning multi-element chain reactions
Build familiarity with the periodic table in an interactive way
how_to_play: Swap two adjacent element tiles to create a match of 3 or more identical elements in a row or column.
Matched elements react and clear from the board, earning you energy points.
Cleared tiles cascade down and new elements fill in from the top — watch for chain reactions!
Longer matches (4 or 5 in a row) earn bonus points and trigger bigger reactions.
You have 25 moves to reach the target score of 500 energy points.
Plan your swaps carefully — efficiency and chain reactions are the key to success!

storybook_pages.title: Welcome to the Chem Lab
storybook_pages.text: The chemistry lab is buzzing with energy! Elements are scattered across the reaction grid, waiting to be combined. Your job: swap adjacent elements to create reactions. When three or more identical elements line up, they react and release energy. The bigger the chain, the bigger the reaction!
storybook_pages.image_prompt: colorful chemistry laboratory with a grid of element tiles on a lab bench, beakers bubbling, periodic table on the wall, young scientist with safety goggles, bright educational cartoon style

storybook_pages.title: Elements in Action
storybook_pages.text: Hydrogen, Oxygen, Carbon, Nitrogen, and Sodium — each element has unique properties. Match Hydrogen for clean energy. Combine Oxygen for combustion reactions. Carbon chains are the building blocks of life. Every match teaches you real chemistry!
storybook_pages.image_prompt: five element characters with their chemical symbols: H2 in red, O2 in teal, C in dark blue, N2 in purple, Na in gold, each showing their personality through cartoon expressions, periodic table background

storybook_pages.title: Master Chemist
storybook_pages.text: As you clear elements and trigger chain reactions, you're learning how real chemical reactions work — atoms combine, energy is released, and new compounds form. Reach the target score to earn your Master Chemist badge!
storybook_pages.image_prompt: completed puzzle grid with explosion effects from chain reactions, energy meters full, a gold trophy shaped like an Erlenmeyer flask, element particles floating around, celebratory cartoon science style

glossary_terms.definition: The process of selecting among alternatives based on available information and values.

glossary_terms.definition: Analyzing information objectively to form a well-reasoned judgment.

glossary_terms.deep_dive: Critical thinking involves identifying assumptions, evaluating evidence, and considering alternative perspectives.

glossary_terms.definition: The belief that abilities can be developed through effort and learning from failure.

cultural_context: Chemistry is a core subject in India's JEE and NEET examinations, which test problem-solving and pattern recognition under pressure. This game builds the molecular thinking and analytical instincts that support academic achievement in Indian science education.
reflection_prompt: Which pattern took longest to spot? How will you train your eye for it next time?
